headline: Outstanding battery and camera clarity
content: Bought Samsung M14 5G for ₹16,999 after discount. The 50MP camera takes crisp photos even in indoor low light. The 6000mAh battery easily lasts 2 full days of moderate usage.

headline: Great value phone under 20k
content: Overall very satisfied with display smooth 90Hz and 5G connectivity. Charger isn't provided in box, but battery life is incredible.

headline: Stunning AMOLED screen and 108MP camera
content: Redmi Note 13 5G display is super bright outdoors. Colors pop up nicely. Fast delivery received in 2 days.

headline: Sleek look and good performance
content: Realme Narzo 60 vegan leather finish looks premium. Camera quality is decent for ₹15k range. Sound output is clear.

headline: Smooth programming experience for code & web dev
content: Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 handles VS Code, Python scripts, Node.js servers seamlessly. Great value laptop under 40k.

headline: Best running shoes under 5000 rupees
content: Puma Velocity Nitro 2 gives amazing cushion rebound while jogging on roads. Grippy outsole on wet roads and super light weight.
